title: Man Shot by ICE Agent Says His Car Was Struck Twice Before He Was Shot
summary: A Venezuelan immigrant, Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, was shot in Austin, Texas, on Sunday after a traffic stop. The shooting prompted calls from local officials for a transparent investigation.
